- `qrow_9709_m25_qp_32_q07::q07/a` → `9709.procedure.differentiation.solve_stationary_point`

This violates #1730's requirement to capture cross-family supporting applications when an owning-scope model already exists. Add the exact mappings and regenerate the delta, cumulative composition/KG, manifest/readback, metrics, and hashes. The current `23` supporting / `132` issue-local instance totals therefore undercount by three.
